license.notes: Original procedural construction. Layer 3 ground cover: a clump of tapered blades marking cracks, moisture, shade and edges. Solid tapered spikes rather than crossed quads -- a single-sided plane is the class of surface this pipeline already spent a session chasing. Height max is 0.10 m, under the 0.117 m unassisted_step_max derived in lot/site_steps.py for this stack's 0.4 m capsule -- so a body steps over it anyway and passing through it is not a false traversal promise. Collisionless by construction. See docs/SURFACE_DRESSING.md. TRANSPARENCY: opaque. Solid tapered blades, no alpha -- the first kit is opaque end to end so density and coverage can be tuned without overdraw or sort order as confounds. An alpha_cutout card variant is the intended next step for denser foliage, per 'coverage first, alpha cutouts second, true transparency only when the material calls for it'.
